  html:

execute:
  echo: false

---

```{r}
#| label: setup
# Run R/01_clean.R to R/04_figure.R first. This report only reads their outputs.
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(gt)

here::i_am("reports/report.qmd")

cleaning_log <- read_csv(here("output", "cleaning_log.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
population   <- read_csv(here("output", "analysis_population.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
model        <- read_csv(here("output", "primary_model.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

arm_effect <- filter(model, term == "armIntensive")
n_analyzed <- sum(population$analyzed)
```

## Summary

In `r n_analyzed` patients with baseline and 12-month systolic BP, the adjusted mean difference in 12-month SBP change (Intensive − Standard) was **`r sprintf("%.1f", arm_effect$estimate)` mmHg** (95% CI `r sprintf("%.1f", arm_effect$conf.low)` to `r sprintf("%.1f", arm_effect$conf.high)`), adjusted for baseline SBP and site.

## Data cleaning

The raw file was not changed. The cleaning script (`R/01_clean.R`) made these changes:

```{r}
#| label: cleaning-log
cleaning_log |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(step = "Step", variable = "Variable", n_changed = "Rows changed", details = "Details")
```

## Analysis population

```{r}
#| label: population
population |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(mean_change, decimals = 1) |>
  cols_label(arm = "Arm", randomized = "Randomized", missing_baseline = "Missing baseline SBP",
             missing_12_months = "Missing 12-month SBP", analyzed = "Analyzed",
             mean_change = "Mean SBP change (mmHg)")
```

## Table 1. Baseline characteristics

```{r}
#| label: table1
n_by_arm <- setNames(population$randomized, population$arm)

read_csv(here("output", "table1.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  gt() |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
  cols_label(
    Overall   = paste0("Overall (N = ", sum(n_by_arm), ")"),
    Intensive = paste0("Intensive (N = ", n_by_arm["Intensive"], ")"),
    Standard  = paste0("Standard (N = ", n_by_arm["Standard"], ")")
  ) |>
  tab_footnote("Mean (SD) or n (%).")
```

## Primary analysis

ANCOVA: `sbp_change ~ arm + sbp_v0 + site`, with Standard as the reference arm.

```{r}
#| label: model
model |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_number(p.value, n_sigfig = 2) |>
  cols_label(term = "Term", estimate = "Estimate", conf.low = "95% CI lower",
             conf.high = "95% CI upper", p.value = "p-value")
```

## Systolic BP over time

![Mean systolic BP (95% CI) by visit and arm](../output/fig_sbp_by_visit.png)

## Limitations

- Complete-case analysis. Loss to follow-up was higher in older patients, so the planned sensitivity analyses (multiple imputation and a mixed model using all visits) should be run.
- Sex codes `1` and `2` were recoded as M and F. This needs confirmation from the data manager.
- `cuff_size` is not in the data dictionary and was not used.
